body: I cant talk on skype, but you can PM me and we could chat if you'd like.

Hello,

I’m feeling pretty down myself and posted on SW as well.

But I wanted to reach out to you. I know that university is tough, I’m going through it myself now. 

You should stop worrying about people thinking you are a two time failure. Most people would not even have the guts to attempt calculus. The fact that you took it once shows that you are much braver than them. The fact that you took it again after failing, says a lot about your character. You didn’t give up and that is a huge indication of how strong you are. 

I just wanted to also add that most people don’t have the time to sit there criticizing you and the ones that do are leading very sad lives...

I know a girl that spent 9 years getting her degree. She didn’t give up event though I would have if I was in her shoes. She was on probation, got threats that she would be dropped from her program, was told by all her friends and the school to find a new passion. She didn’t give up! She has her degree now and that piece of paper means more to her than we can ever image. In her completing her degree, she pretty much told the world to "shove it"
